name: Wungwut Ngam
instructions: 1. Marinate the chicken pieces with ginger paste, garlic paste, and salt.
2. In a bowl, mix the rice flour with a little water to create a thick paste or batter.
3. Add the marinated chicken into the rice flour mixture and coat evenly.
4. Heat water in a pot and add the chicken mixture, bringing it to a boil.
5. Cook on medium heat until the chicken is tender and the rice flour has thickened the broth into a gravy consistency.
6. Garnish with chopped green chilies and local herbs before serving hot.
description: Wungwut Ngam is a staple delicacy of the Tangsa tribe. It is highly valued for its simple, rustic preparation that highlights the natural flavors of the meat thickened with the starch of rice flour, often prepared during communal feasts or special tribal gatherings.
